result.brief: 提出视频-EMG配对数据集与跨模态传感器运动对齐预训练，学习共享视觉-运动动作表征，并用于EMG条件视频扩散生成。
result.reason: Introduces paired video-EMG dataset and cross-modal sensorimotor pretraining that improves video visual representations, plus EMG-conditioned video diffusion; directly a video representation learning contribution.
